text: Within the walls of the Academy, wine-making is both an art and an arcane tradition.
zh: 在学院的高墙之内，酿酒既是一门艺术，也是一项秘传的传统。

text: The mages and their novices cultivate vines within the academy grounds, carefully tending to the vines using their agricultural techniques.
zh: 法师和见习生们在学院的园地里栽种葡萄藤，运用他们的农艺技术悉心照料。

text: Once harvested, the grapes undergo meticulous fermentation and aging in carefully maintained cellars, preserving their quality.
zh: 葡萄收获之后，会在精心维护的酒窖中经过细致的发酵与陈酿，以保其品质。

text: The resulting wines are highly sought-after by the people of Grenmark and beyond due to their extraordinary flavor.
zh: 酿成的葡萄酒风味非凡，深受格伦马克乃至更远之地人们的追捧。

text: The Academy remains true to the essence of the grape and does not mix its wines with other flavors or ingredients.
zh: 学院始终忠于葡萄的本味，绝不在酒中掺入其他风味或原料。
